text:
incident-bot: Pager sent to #incidents (sev1) — errorwave detected: elevated 5xx/timeouts across control-plane gateways. Affected deps: auth, org-lookup, billing, config-service. Auto-run checks: gateway-5xx-rate > 5% for 3m, auth-500s spiking. Please acknowledge.

maria.g: acked. i'm on it — gathering dashboard links.

ashok: ack. quick ask: are load balancers healthy? looks like upstream timeouts. linking graphs: https://dash/redwood/controlplane/errors?range=15m

sre-liz: seeing lots of 502 from gateway -> org-lookup, and 504s from gateway -> billing. 95p latency for billing jumped to 2.3s. possible cascade.

maria.g: customer impact: some org creation and billing-related flows failing with 503/504s. tickets coming in: ~30 errors/min. recommend emergency mitigations: 1) enable cached-org-lookup fallback, 2) throttle non-essential config refreshes, 3) open temporary read-only mode for org writeops if needed.

ashok: can do cached fallback toggle now. command: `kubectl -n controlplane set env deployment/org-lookup FALLBACK_MODE=cached`

ashok: (runs) -> output: `deployment.apps/org-lookup patched`

sre-liz: watch logs while that rolls:
```
gateway 2026-03-15T12:04:17Z ERROR upstream_timeouts: 502 auth svc (10.0.12.3): timeout after 1.2s
gateway 2026-03-15T12:04:18Z ERROR upstream_timeouts: 504 billing svc (10.0.14.8): read timeout
org-lookup 2026-03-15T12:04:19Z WARN cache_miss: user lookup miss for org_id=...
```

maria.g: good. early telemetry shows auth failures decreased ~30% after fallback. billing still sticky.

eng-jun: jumping in — any recent deploys for billing or config in the last 30m?

oncall-c: i didn't see any deploys in the window. infra autoscaling kicked but didn't help. paging sig: escalate to eng if we can't stabilise in 10m.

ashok: trying to mitigate billing: adding short circuit to return 503 for heavy, nonessential billing checks to avoid long tail. applying rate limit on /billing/check endpoint: `ratelimit set billing-check 100r/s`

ashok: (run) -> `ratelimit updated`

sre-liz: after ratelimit: billing p95 dropped from 2.3s -> 1.1s, 5xx rate down 18%. still above baseline.

maria.g: comms note: impact to org creation and billing verification. recommend status page banner + RM ticket. assigning comms to @eng-jun to draft a short message for affected customers.

eng-jun: drafting: `We're investigating elevated errors for org creation and billing checks. Some requests may return 502/503. Mitigation in progress.` will post in 5.

maria.g: handoff: i'm handing primary oncall to eng-jun for deeper root cause — pls post all findings here. ashok/sre-liz remain for mitigation ops.

eng-jun: taking it. initial hypothesis: a config-service rollout earlier may have introduced backpressure to billing via an increased validation path. pulling logs and traces now.

sre-liz: adding trace snippet for a failed trace id=tr_0x9a8b:
```
trace tr_0x9a8b: gateway -> config-service (120ms) -> billing (timeout) -> 504
tags: route=/billing/check, user_agent=service-worker, retries=0
```

eng-jun: confirmed a config-service broadcast increased concurrent validation calls to billing. patching a quick throttle in config-service to reduce fanout: `CONFIG_VALIDATION_MAX_CONCURRENCY=16` and redeploy.

eng-jun: (deploy) -> `rolling update started: config-service`

sre-liz: metrics: after throttle, gateway 5xx dropped another ~22%. billing latency now trending down.

oncall-c: ok — mitigation working. let's keep this as sev2 and continue monitoring, move to postmortem once stable. we should still prepare customer follow-ups for orgs that failed to create (retries/backfill).

maria.g: agreed. checklist for post-incident: timeline, root cause (config fanout -> billing overload), mitigations applied (org-lookup cached fallback, billing ratelimit, config throttle), customer impact summary, follow-ups (increase billing queue capacity, add circuit breaker on billing, add canary for config rollouts).

eng-jun: i'll open a follow-up ticket and assign owners. Ticket: RDW-INC-2243 (will include timeline + traces).

ashok: unlocking runbook note: next time, if billing p95 > 2s and 5xx>3% for 5m, flip config fanout to safe-mode before fallback.

maria.g: posting status page now. thanks all — i'll keep monitoring for 30m then transition to incident review. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident update: mitigations applied, errorwave stabilizing. Monitoring will continue.
